title: Tactical Chest Bag – Adjustable with Multiple Compartments
descriptionHtml:
Carry everything you need – quickly accessible

On the hike or at the gym you want your phone, keys and small items close. A regular bag swings around and has to be taken off to get to things.

Secure fit and many compartments

This tactical chest bag sits securely with adjustable straps and has several zippered compartments. Everything stays in place even when you move fast.

Features

  • Several zippered compartments
  • Adjustable straps for a secure fit
  • Secure compartment for valuables
  • Stylish and practical black design
  • Great for running, hiking and everyday use

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
